notes: Bin geometry is slightly polygonal/hexagonal rather than strictly square

blind.description: A low, hexagonal or polygonal wooden slat compost bin filled with decaying organic matter, vegetable scraps, leaves, and compost. The structure is built from reddish-brown timber corner posts and horizontal slatted fence planks with gaps between them. One front side has a lower profile/opening. Inside, the compost pile consists of textured organic mulch, brown decaying vegetation, and green plant scraps. The geometry is solid, stylised, and intact with no floating parts or holes. It stands directly on the ground on its corner posts/legs without an added base slab.
blind.from_above: A roughly hexagonal wooden frame surrounding a dense bed of brown organic debris mixed with green scraps and leaves.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 to 2.5 feet tall (roughly knee-height or a little over one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
